t: Complete the trial in Ionas’ Underground Labyrinth.

The Underground Labyrinth is ready to challenge its visitors! If you are brave enough, you are welcome!

This is the trial of silence. Your speed doesn’t matter - you just need to sneak past the guards without getting them to notice you.

Are you ready to enter the Labyrinth?
Are you ready to enter the Labyrinth?
The Labyrinth has released the winner! Here is your reward.
Complete Dionic Games: Underground Labyrinth with extra objectives:

If you find my challenge too easy, let's add some flavor to the game!

Free all three captives and bring them to the center simultaneously. Make sure no minotaurs notice you and avoid traps.

Only then will I name you the Master of my Labyrinth!
Are you ready to accept my challenge?
Well done, Stormbringer! You learned a lot from years of saving the innocent.
Complete Ionas’ trials in the Underground Labyrinth. Report on the results.
Good news, Stormbringer - we’re almost done. I think you should be the first one to try it out! And tell us what you think of our work.
I wonder what you think of our work!

Excellent! The Labyrinth works exactly how we intended it to. And the Minotaurs are doing a great job!

Thank you for your help. I’m not going to take any more of your time - somebody else might need you, too!
Help Awki Black-Feather and pick up the order from Dermos in Polis.

What a wonder... hic... ful day, friend! I have never seen so many awesome creatures in one place! Maybe these Games are a good idea after all - what do you think, Stormbringer?

Every Dominus has something special prepared for our guests, and I am no exception. However, my trial is rather humble. Just flying on Pegasi! Have you seen their wings? Those noble creatures were born to... hic... dominate the skies!

Though Pegasi’s temper is horrible. Those creatures are mean! I asked the Aviaks for help - they surely know how to deal with the winged beasts. The Aviak chieftain was willing to help and he sent his own son - you can find him near the stables if you wish to give him a hand. Awki was his name, I think, hic...

Oh, I almost forgot! I’ve got to collect my order from that leatherworker in Polis. I would be so grateful if you could do it for me!
Dermos has crafted something very special for me! I can’t wait to see it...

Oh, poor winged things. Well, they deserved that! At least it will teach them some humbleness.

What about my order? Was it ready? Ah, so you’ve seen it already... Well, I guess now you know what’s waiting for our guests! Thank you for your help, friend!

How about taking a ride?

Cuat-cuarh, wingless! Did you come to mock Awki? My father sure did me a favor, carh!

What? You came to help? Well then let me apologize. My name is Awki Black-Feather. I am the eldest son of our chieftain... sent by him to tame the damned Pegasi! For some reason that drunk Aoidos thinks that if those horses have wings they can speak to Aviaks in the tongue of the skies! Cur-cul! How ridiculous is that?

However, the root of the problem is obvious to me. Those mares are too proud. They were born to fly and not to rot in stables, cuarh! In order to tame Pegasi, you first need to break their spirit.
I hope the Spring Spirit gets enraged, cuat!

Cua-ha-ha, good job, wingless! Look at these pathetic beasts! No pride left in them. They’ve learned their lesson.

I guess my job here is done. Thank you for your help! If you don’t mind, I will take this stone. I know somebody who might need it, cuarh!

Dominus Dionysius told me he would send someone to pick up his order. I didn’t think he would dare to ask the savior of our people! Maybe he had his reasons.

It wasn’t easy, but me and Dione did what he asked us of. Dominus wanted us to craft flying balls! They are here, in this bag.

Wait, don’t open it!

Ah, here are the balls! I hope they didn’t get you in trouble? Dione is a talented sorceress, but sometimes her creations are way too... animated.

No? Good!

Have you already been to the dark underground labyrinth and raced on the track of Dionic Archipelago? Now it’s time to fly high in the skies!

And also participate in the Air Triathlon! If you wish, Stormbringer, I will gladly tell you about the rules.

Are you ready to conquer the skies of Dionic Archipelago?
Are you ready to conquer the skies of Dionic Archipelago?
That was a beautiful flight! Here is your reward.
Complete Dionic Games: Air Triathlon with extra objectives:

You must know that the most difficult part of air triathlon is catching the elusive ghostly ball. Some would catch it just once and consider themselves lucky...

Your task, however, is to catch 5 swift balls!

In addition to that, you must fly through all the rings as fast as you can, throw all balls at the first try, and earn at least 160 points.

And that is my challenge.
Start the trial as soon as you are ready.
The sky is the limit! Well done, Stormbringer!

So Propegasius... hic... taught you everything about the winged horses. Now let’s turn it into a trial!

I’m curious how this is going to work... Good luck, Stormbringer!

I think the trial works! This makes me happy.

Thank you for your help. Dionysius is ready for the Games!
Complete flight training from the flight instructor.

Before you soar up, Stormbringer, you need to learn something about the winged creatures. If you don’t understand how to treat them, they will just throw you off their back!

So first you need to approach the flight instructor and ask him to teach you. Good luck!
Can anything be more beautiful than flying in the skies?

When you’re standing next to a ball, use “Catch the ball” ability to... catch the ball!

Try and catch this blue one above us.
h: How do I catch a ball?

t:
Mount the Pegasus and use “Wing Swing” ability. You’ll see what happens next...

Get into the air and fly three times through any rings above us.

When there’s a ring in front of you, use “Throw the ball” ability and try to be precise!

Now get into the air and try to throw two balls into the ring above us.
h: How do I throw a ball?

t:
Well, you’re not hopeless. Go back to Dionysius and tell him you’re ready.

If you have any questions, shoot away!
I will teach you how to fly Pegasi! Whether you want it or not.

Dionic Archipelago is inside a time loop right now. I created it in my Observatory. The loop is very short - only those three seconds that keep us all from dying. Three seconds of total terror and helpless rage. I am powerful, Stormbringer, but I won’t be able to sustain it for a long time. You have to be fast.

I used the powers of the Observatory to take us to the past - to the moment right before the loop closes, so that we can destroy Ionas’ creation. If you manage to do this, it will protect us from the temporal paradox, and those who remain outside the loop will only see the arrival of Nihaz and your following battle with him.

I’m sorry, it sounds too complicated, but believe me - when the time tries to heal itself, weird things happen.

Now go!

About time... I’d congratulate you on victory, but that wouldn’t be sincere. The war against Nihaz is only beginning.

The loop is unraveling right now. You better not leave the Observatory for the next couple minutes. You and I don’t belong to the current time on Sarnaut right now, so we can, um... Fall out of reality like undesirable elements.

Trust me, that is much worse than death.
Leave the Observatory and tell Klavdia Kalugina about what happened.

It’s not getting any easier...  I’ve been getting deja vu all morning... Huh? Don't worry about that, it’s just a fashionable elf word.

I would never trust that Dominus of Creation. Who knows what he wants and what he is capable of! We don’t even know what he wants with Nihaz. Unleashing the Dark God on this shattered world is the last thing we need... And how he poisoned his own sister because she was getting in his way with her gift of foresight!

Believe me, I’ve met some super-powered smarty pants before. I used to be one. This is going nowhere good. Creation, destiny, a universal deeper meaning, purpose – ha! I know Aoidoi want to believe in higher powers and some Great Design. But if I’ve learned anything in my life, it’s that Creation doesn’t care about this small, ragged artificial world filled with all sorts of creatures.

We’re on our own. It’s terrible. And great at the same time.
Report to Cassandra on delivering the invitation.

Astral silver is an extremely rare mineral with vivid magical properties. Working with it requires much caution. One wrong move, and it can destroy a whole allod. This one must have been Cosmos’ work - I wonder if all Aoidoi are capable of handling it?

Well, the Aoidoi wish to see us in their home, and they even invited you personally. I think we should accept that invitation. Take part in their Games as a champion of the Empire! Be careful - the League is going to participate as well.

Here you are! I was starting to get worried. The guests are arriving to Ammer in great numbers - we can barely greet everyone.

I guess the Empire has accepted our invitation - I can see their ships in our harbor. And the League is here! Perfect!
Report to Cassandra on delivering the invitation.

Astral silver is an extremely rare mineral with vivid magical properties. Working with it requires much caution. One wrong move, and it can destroy a whole allod. This one must have been Cosmos’ work - I wonder if all Aoidoi are capable of handling it?

Well, the Aoidoi wish to see us in their home, and they even invited you personally. I think we should accept that invitation. Take part in their Games as a champion of the League! Be careful - the Empire is going to participate as well.

Here you are! I was starting to get worried. The guests are arriving to Ammer in great numbers - we can barely greet everyone.

I guess the League has accepted our invitation - I can see their ships in our harbor. And the Empire is here! Perfect!
Greet the guests of Dionic Games.

I must say I thought it would be more difficult to invite some of our guests. We have Mountainfolk, Minotaurs, Sea creatures, Tekyans here... As mad as he was, Sarn’s creations are truly beautiful! Everybody is setting up their temporary houses right now - Ammer will become their home for a long time.

Many in Sarnaut know your name, Stormbringer. And many will be pleased to see you, though some may have their fears... The sooner you get to know everyone, the better. And you should also greet your old friends, right?
I’m happy to see so many guests on Ammer.
Here you are. It’s been a long day, but I think we found homes for all of our guests. Now it’s time the opening ceremony... and I have a request for you.
Participate in the opening ceremony of Dionic Games by carrying the holy fire to the statue of Thalos. Listen to the Dominae speech.

If it hadn’t been for you, Stormbringer, our house wouldn’t be here now. If Kyros had succeeded... the world would have been deprived of immortality, and its enraged people would have wiped us off the face of Sarnaut. But you won in the battle with fate itself. We are alive, and we thank you.

You would do us a great honor if you agreed to perform the opening ceremony for our feast of peace. May everyone see how you ignite the fire which is the symbol of universal brotherhood! You are a living legend.

Would you do that?
My kin knows how to make a feast out of nothing.

So, my job at Dionic Games is done.

But don’t think my kin will leave you alone. There’s plenty of work to do. You see Amos? See how sad he is? He must be really struggling with something. And Ionas? You know when was the last time he slept? Everyone’s busy, busy, busy!

I’ll go get some rest.
Meet Cassandra in Polis on Ammer.

I have good news, Stormbringer. The Well has healed its wounds, and Domina Kora is again welcoming newborn Aoidoi to our world.

I have no words to thank you for what you did for us.

But I need to talk to you in person. Please find me in Polis as soon as possible.

Yours sincerely, Domina Cassandra.

Welcome again, Stormbringer. A lot has changed here since we last met.

I apologize for being so vague in my letter. But I had my reasons.

Well, I should have guessed. Even the brightest of minds can’t take a stand against the masses. Dust fighting dust, year after year, century after century. Fate has given them common enemies, but they still can’t forget their strife. It’s a shame. But this is how our primitive society works.

Except our next enemy can just wipe us all off the face of Sarnaut.

Nihaz is coming.

What are you going to do?
h: Tell about the stands of the League and the Empire

t: My people call me the Dominus of Creation. May it be so.

Neither Klavdia nor Catherina consulted me when they started building these Gates-3. Now you are reaping the fruits of your own recklessness. The Observatory's gaze is directed into the future, and I can say that the likelihood of the Darkness coming to our world has not decreased, but increased.

Nihaz and his followers are cunning - they will find a way to turn everything you do to their advantage.

Luckily for you, I have taken steps of my own to repel a future onslaught on Sarnaut.
h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
As I wrote to you, a newborn Aoidos has emerged from the Well. We were afraid it would never happen again.

Our new brother has become a new Dominus. This is the highest title we could give him, but in truth he is much stronger than all of us.

His name is Cosmos, and he bears the title of Dominus of Creation. He is eager to meet you, but he doesn’t say why. But I’m sure that must be a strong reason.

Ah, here is my hero. Let me look at you...

I wonder what you are?

I’ve been watching you for a while now... I can see you are surprised. You will understand later. Just be sure that I’m not your enemy. And I hope it will remain this way.

My name is Cosmos.

Let me thank you personally for what you did in Secret Paths. Defeating Maverick is a much greater deed that it might seem! But I assume you didn’t think you actually killed him. That rascal was a Dark God’s servant... Though I can’t understand why would anyone want to be an adept of deception and destruction.

However, the tactics of the Great Mages is also beyond my comprehension. What are Aidenus, Yasker, Caterina, Zayan, Klavdia waiting for? Do they really think their job is done?
It’s time for us to talk.

But there is a more pressing issue for the Aoidoi right now. They decided to throw a grand event to mark my birthday - the day when the Well started giving life again.

And they want to invite whole Sarnaut to celebrate!
Bring the invitation to Yasker in Nezebgrad.

Dominae of Aoidoi - and I am one of them now - wish to invite representatives of all the sentient races of Sarnaut to Ammer for a celebration.

This will be an unusual event. We call it Dionic Games. Our guests will be offered to participate in athletic competitions under the aegis of peace and mutual respect. The champion will be rewarded with the symbol of peace - a spear made of Astral silver.

Don’t worry - I will take care of everyone’s safety in my land.

Take this message to Yasker. Don’t try to read it - the writing is enchanted. I personally invite you to participate in the Games.

This is all very sweet, but we don’t have time for their childish games - we have the League and Nezeb knows who attacking us constantly!

Wait... A spear of Astral silver? How is this even possible?

Everything is so pink and shiny. The ladies are pretty, huh.

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m in the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.

It must be nice to live without war. Maybe we can teach the younger generation to be friendlier...

Because if we don’t, we all just might die out one day, haha!
h: So how do you like Ammer?

t:
Oh, I know you. You’re the hero of Dane!

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m from the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.

Interesting! It’s a bit of a pity that I didn’t get to take part in this Expedition… But they don't trust me since I'm an orc, heh.

Felix was put in charge, and only the most reliable orcs were selected.

Therefore, I wish you success. But as a veteran, I will watch from the sidelines.
h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
What advice do you want from me?

We are the residents of Sarnaut, which means we must act in the interests of our world, and not some other.

Moreover, we don't need those who want to impose their will. We will impose our own order! The time of Trees and shamans has long passed...

What?! This girl thinks too much of herself, hah.

If I see her, I'll thrash her with a belt. Right there in the square. I'll show her a damn rebellion...

Oh, my daughter. Yes, the trouble is, while the father was shedding blood on the frontline, the troublemaker grew up as bold as brass.

In short, tell her I'm going to thrash her with a belt when I see her. Right there in the square. I'll show her a damn rebellion...
h: Would you like me to give a message to Fury?

t: Bring the invitation to Aidenus in Novograd.

Dominae of Aoidoi - and I am one of them now - wish to invite representatives of all the sentient races of Sarnaut to Ammer for a celebration.

This will be an unusual event. We call it Dionic Games. Our guests will be offered to participate in athletic competitions under the aegis of peace and mutual respect. The champion will be rewarded with the symbol of peace - a spear made of Astral silver.

Don’t worry - I will take care of everyone’s safety in my land.

Take this message to Aidenus. Don’t try to read it - the writing is enchanted. I personally invite you to participate in the Games.

This is all very sweet, but we don’t have time for their childish games - we have the Empire and Light knows who attacking us constantly!

Wait... A spear of Astral silver? How is this even possible?
Visit the piers and inform them that no one is allowed to leave. Ask the gondoliers if anyone important has left Irene.

We have a serious problem, .

The thing is, Lucretia was a keeper of one of the most important artifacts of our people... And today a friend has visited Us – Cardinal Renard de Ardeur. He informed Us that his supporters from the Great Houses that oppose neutrality would like to see this artifact at the Great Ball. We started to doubt whether the queen still has it.

And as you can guess, Lucretia indeed no longer has it. We will forgive her this mistake, because she is just a woman, and they can be naive when it comes to love.

During their meeting, she gave it to her lover. Alas, Eurial found out and informed the cardinal, and he decided to take advantage of it.

We don’t want our spouse to be disgraced, so We’ll have to help her. Besides... We’d like to get the artifact back. Talk to her and find out how it can be done.
Now We know what to do next. We only need to get the truth out of Tassilon de Ardeur, and We have an idea...
Find out where the messenger went.

Tassilon de Ardeur is not a fool, and he can be quite adamant, but Blanche is really good at her job. She already told us about his weakness: poor concentration. If you put pressure on him from several sides, he'll probably break. Let's discuss this in detail.
You're too late... Eurial has already left in pursuit!
Hm, this is a lovely city. I could live here.

Whaaat? What love?

Oh, right! I know. Who are you? Where's the harpy?
Find the general's camp on Ferris.

Yes, I'll tell you everything... I know who you're looking for. Eurial and her Lamias have been looking for him, too. I'll tell you what I told her: he went to Ferris two days ago. That's all I know, I swear! I'm just a gondolier, no one lets me in on any details! You should hurry, because that viper is hot on his trail... You won't let her hurt me, right?
Then don't dawdle. We'll ensure you'll have no problems with the portals.
Chase down Eurial and take the artifact from her.

Oh... It's hard to breathe... I think I'm frozen to the ground...

I missed my shift! Eurial caught up with us, slaughtered everyone in the camp... General Bekin tried to save the artifact and escape, but Eurial went after him. Perhaps everything is already over... Cough, cough...

But if there's a chance we can stop her, we should do it!
Thank you, friend! If it weren't for you...
Take the Dragon Bond and return it to Queen Lucretia de Desirae on Irene.

You need the Dragon Bond? Very well, I'll give it to you.

Who could have though there'd be so many deaths because of this artifact...

It's too bad our expedition ended in failure. Well, take it and return to Ker-Is. Give Lucretia the proof of my feelings, and let her know: no obstacles can keep loving hearts apart!
Well, ? Did you retrieve the artifact? Hurry, please! The Ball is about to start!

My gratitude knows no bound! Not only did you save my reputation before the Great Ball, you also kept a dangerous artifact from falling into Eurial's hands.

I and Louis will find out who she is and who is behind all this.

I would like to reward you and those two Aviak heroes that accompanied you... But I don't see them. Perhaps they got delayed. I hope we'll see them later.
Sneak into Eurial's residence and search for information.

! I believe it's time for decisive but careful actions. We need to find out what Eurial is hiding and who she works for.

Tailing her would be too risky. Wriggling into her favor? Seems unlikely. We'll have to resort to good old espionage.

A great opportunity has just presented itself – there's a private gathering tonight at her residence, but Eurial herself won't be there. There's no legit way in, so we'll have to be creative...

We'll send one of our trusted mages behind the Theater. From there, he'll be able to teleport you to Eurial's island. It's bold, so no one will be expecting that. Then you'll have to... Improvise. We don't doubt your talents. Go now.
Oh, dear. What an unexpected meeting... We didn't expect to see you here. Or are you in cahoots with that viper? Explain yourself.
Ah, that's wise! You can go anywhere, there are no secrets. Just stay away from the door guarded by the lamia - it's a private zone, only for the best customers, like me...
h: It's my first time here, I don't want any trouble.

t: Ahhh! You're not the only one... Now go... Bring me some wine...
h: I'm a secret admirer of Eurial and would like to know everything about her...

t: I see you're off your rocker! Go away... And come back with wine...
h: I'm a spy looking for secret information!

t: How would I know? I haven't been there. But the place is packed right now, so with your talents you'll be able to get lost in the crowd. You'll figure out the rest.
Escort the queen and her servant to the meeting.

I doubt anyone is surprised to hear Eurial is involved in some dark dealings. We'll sort this out, but for now...

We'd be grateful if you found time to help Our spouse, Lucretia. We don't know the details, but she absolutely needs an outsider's help, one she can trust. Speak with her.
Thank you. I hope no one followed us?
Leave Eurial's residence and report to Louis.
Listen, I'm in a bad mood. So just do what I tell you to do. As a favor a friend, alright? First explain what you're doing here.
I knew there was something fishy about this...
There will be no "later"! You do realize you either hand it to us, or we'll... take it, right?
h: I'm afraid I can't do that. But later...

t: Guard the doors until the queen is done.
We made it, now we need to wait for the queen. I think I heard something...
Was the queen's problem taken care of?

Well... Of course, We know all about her flings. We are a royal couple, after all. Occasionally, We ourselves indulge... But this is not the time. The problem is not Lucretia's indiscretions, but the fact that someone is actively trying to besmirch her reputation. And we need to find out exactly what is going on.
Demonstrate your manners to the guests of Irene.

Oh, ! We know you've been on the road for years...

And in that time, you manners have gotten a little "rusty"? Yes, that's the word... At any rate, We wouldn't want our guests to side-eye you. But they will! If you give them a reason.

So We started a small school of good manners and etiquette. Simple rules of conduct that are obvious to everyone on this allod... Cecilia de Grandeur is in charge of the lessons. But it looks like someone from another House would like to assist her: Solemna de Ardeur. I believe together they can handle it.

Go to the park in front of the palace and complete a course on these manners. Perhaps you'll need more than one lesson. If that's the case, repeat it a few times.

Excellent, !

I believe you won't have any problems at the next Great Ball.
Help Giacomo stay out of trouble.

We'd like to tell you something, ... Our subjects are like children to us. We love them all, but it's difficult to keep peace among children, especially when they gather like this...

There are some who occupy themselves above all with... amorous adventures. Well, why shouldn't they? Can't tame a wild heart...

One of our old acquaintances is an elf named Giacomo de Vevre. He is a legend among the ladies, and we follow his adventures with great interest. He stopped counting his conquests a long time ago, there are just too many. But as the number of his conquests grows, so does the number of enraged husbands who do not enjoy being cuckolded.

I'm afraid Giacomo might get in trouble. We don't want that to happen. So please, find him and find out if he is in trouble.

Wonderful, !

Hopefully my friend will be more careful next time.

But... probably not.
Ugh... I can't run anymore... If you want to beat me up, do it. Just don't make me run...
Win 3 duels on Irene (you can fight elven duelers and other players).

! We would like to share one of Our troubles...

Right now we have representatives of various Houses on Irene. Any competition between them breeds rivalry, which in turn leads to conflicts. We are saddened to see Our subjects try and skewer each other with their crude weapons...

We are talking about this novelty – duels. And not those noble magical duels, but fencing. It's a new trend among the youth that was most likely invented by other races. Duels continue in spite of Our edict which forbids them!

Unfortunately, many elves are proud of their accomplishments in this field... We'd like you to teach a lesson to several brawlers... Prove they know nothing!

Very good, !

I hope their bloodlust is satiated for the time being.
To what do I owe the pleasure...?

Oh, ! I've heard about your skills.

You wish to challenge me? Go ahead!
Take part in a play of the touring Miracle Theatre.

! It should be obvious by now, but it's not just the representatives of the seven Great Houses that came to Irene.

Some elves prefer to stay incognito for one reason or another. I remember when Our son also hid this identity under the guise of the Nameless one... Ugh, so tasteless...

But We have taken an interest in another guest, someone called Stranger, the owner of the Miracle Theatre which is staging a play about the destruction of Irene. They say people laugh and cry in turns during the performance...

We got curious. We would like you to investigate... in other words, visit them and see everything for yourself, then report to Us what you've seen.
We could hear the applause even here. Wonderful! When this mess is over, We will ask them to stage a play just for Us. With you in the cast, of course!

We have three roles in our play: King Grallon, his daughter Princess Daguta, and the mysterious Traveler whose name is unknown. You can choose any of the roles. Talk to me when you do. Hurry, because someone else may pick the role.

Our audience experiences a range of emotions during the performance. We must ensure that the play elicits all sorts of emotions from them. So a good actor watches the audience, trying to engage them with their acting. Give them a full spectrum of emotions – and they will be elated!

Perhaps we won't find enough actors for the play... But that's alright! My assistants will fill in the rest of the roles. Of course, it's better when characters are played by people who understand each other, so if you have friends who might be interested – invite them here.
h: How do I take part in the play?

t: Oh, it's very simple. I'll tell you when the time comes. For now, just enjoy the performance of others.
h: How do I take part in the play?

t:
Oh, it's a famous story closely tied to Irene!

The last elven kingdom used to be here. During the Cataclysm, it survived only thanks to a mysterious artifact that King Grallon kept close – the Key of Creation. The king had a daughter, young Princess Daguta who was trying to get herself a husband.

Everything was fine until a mysterious Stranger showed up at the gates, guided by his own ambitions and desires! He seduced Daguta, compelled her to steal the Key, and thus doomed them all!

King Grallon escaped with a handful of courtiers, and they watched Irene sink into the Astral. But as we know now, the allod wasn't completely destroyed \...

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

What role would you like to play?

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Oh no, don't answer! I can already see you on the stage of my Theatre! When the time comes...
I have a role for you in the next act. You just need to wait for it to start!

You look gorgeous as this character!

Now act!

Theater! What can be better than theater? You can experience the whole range of emotions! Tell me, what do you prefer? Crying, laughing, or unbridled fury?

Do you want to try?

Speak with me before the next act begins, and I will let you pick a role!

Nonsense.

That's right, this is Corinne's mask, my theater's lead actress.

But you're wrong to think that the mask was lost, and you've found it. On the contrary, the mask found you. It chose you.
h: Your actress loses a mask. Here she is.

t: Visit the Rose and Hibiscus and learn the secrets of the patrons.

Alas, this quest will not be implemented.

Louis has taken an interest in an establishment called the Rose and Hibiscus. The player needs to visit the place and try to learn something about the patrons. It would also be nice if you helped the House de Delice that owns this establishment. Daily quest: spy on the patrons (you can place hidden cameras), add something to drinks, bribe the strippers, and other interactive things.
Even a hero like you needs to let off some steam now and then, yes?
Here! And watch the timer: if the enchantment runs out, and you are still in the air... Poof! You fly straight into the Astral.
h: Borrow the Mask of the Free Bird

t: Become a double agent and obtain information.

! You must have already noticed that this time certain mysterious visitors have interfered with our Big Game.

We expected something like that. The League and the Empire aren't the only ones to take interest in the Great Ball. There are a lot of other forces in the world. Nihaz. The Architect. Dragons. Tep knows who else.

In any case, we can't just sit around. Our potential... enemy has set up a network of agents on Irene. My favorite Blanche, who is also the head of our intelligence, and I have come up with a plan. You'll play the leading part.

You must become a double agent. We know where the enemy unit commander will be today. He gives instructions and passwords to other members of the unit. Act quickly! Passwords can change in a jiff, and the same goes for the agents' location.

Blanche will tell you more. Carnal delights isn't the only thing she's good at. She's also smart. You'll see.

You're a natural-born spy, !

I like clever agents. When the Ball is over, we can discuss our mutually beneficial arrangement in a more... intimate setting. How does that sound?
What's wrong, Guest of Irene? Are you bored?
Would the Guest like to play a part in a play?
Does the Guest like to wear masks?

Oh Tep, the people I have to work with... We always meet with our informers somewhere we won't draw attention: in a theatre, in a square in the northern district, in the garden near the palace, in the middle of the main street, near a brothel, or at the lake at the Secluded Sanctuary. If you forget this again...
h: Could you remind me where our meeting points are?

t: Is this your first time? I think I've seen you before... Hmm. You'll recognize them easily - by their carnival mask. Or should I also tell you what an informer does?
h: How do I recognize the informer?

t: He will be waiting for you SOMEWHERE HIGH WHERE VOICES CANNOT BE HEARD.
h: Where do I look for the informer?

t: He will be waiting for you WHERE THE STONE GUARDS ARE SLEEPING.
h: Where do I look for the informer?

t: He will be waiting for you WHERE YOU CAN HEAR THE APPLAUSE.
h: Where do I look for the informer?

t: He will be waiting for you IN THE GOLDEN GARDEN AT THE KEY POINT.
h: Where do I look for the informer?

t: He will be waiting for you NEAR IMMORAL BEAUTY.
h: Where do I look for the informer?

t: He will be waiting for you BETWEEN THE DWELLING OF SHIPS AND THE HOUSE OF FOOLS.
h: Where do I look for the informer?

t:
Find our informer. He'll give you the information and tell you who it's meant for. But be careful: sometimes Irene intelligence replaces our informers with their agents, and if they catch you, they'll know you're one of us. Remember: our informers never carry a weapon.

But if you were, say, a double agent, you could still tell them everything and get what you need... What was I talking about?
Intelligence reports that our current password is TERIONTADOH.
Intelligence reports that our current password is MIASTRINIT.
Intelligence reports that our current password is MIASTRAINIT.
Intelligence reports that our current password is MIRASTINIT.
Intelligence reports that our current password is TERINOTADOH.
Intelligence reports that our current password is TORIENTADOH.
Intelligence reports that our current password is PERISKIAL.
Intelligence reports that our current password is PERIASKAL.
Intelligence reports that our current password is PESKIRIAL.
Intelligence reports that our current password is SHERKUILOAN.
Intelligence reports that our current password is SHEKURIOLAN.
Intelligence reports that our current password is SHELIKURION.
He should be at the harbor now.
h: Where can I find the Harlequins' puppeteer agent?

t: You can find him in the palace square.
h: Where can I find the puppeteer agent?

t: He should be in the Hornbeam Alley now.
h: Where can I find the puppeteer agent?

t: Take part in the race on Irene.

! Irene offers all kinds of entertainment.

Races, for example... House de Ardeur is known as a vehicle manufacturer.

Wraith is their most famous one. But they experiment with other mounts, too. Hares, for instance. I don’t know what they inject their furry butts with, but these hares jump higher than the tallest trees.

We think you should try and master it. It will improve your reputation among our nobility which adores gambling and races.

Excellent, !

Did you enjoy the ride? Quite an experience. Blanche and I want to try it some day.
Participate in the big dance in the main dancing hall of Galleon.

I'm glad to see you, !

What's the most important thing at the Ball? Not intrigues or conspiracies... it's dancing! We believe any elven lady will agree. We also share this opinion.

Each of the Great Balls was memorable for its dances. Declining an invitation to dance from an elf would be a grave offence to them. And since our Ball is in full swing, it's time for dancing!

This time the House de Blizare has come up with something unusual... You will have to check it out. Go to the Galleon Castle and take part in the activities.

That was fantastic, !

Dancing makes the ball! You must do it again sometime.

The dance starts here in the Ballroom every 15 minutes.

To participate, you need a dance partner. Many people gather in the hall before the dance. Among them are the elves of great houses and guests from other lands, like you. Invite someone.

Then wait until I give the signal.

If this is your first time here, don't worry. We made sure even inexperienced dancers can perform the Ice Dance. The guiding aura will show you where to go, and I will tell you which pirouettes you need to perform during the dance. The better your dancing, the higher His Majesty will rate your talent, and the more ecu you will earn.

It might be difficult at first, but you will master it after a few dances. If you still feel unsure, talk to me before the dancing starts. I will enchant your skates, and they will move around the room on their own - you will only need to perform pirouettes.

The hardest thing for a beginner is to keep up with the guiding aura. I can enchant your skates so they follow it automatically. All you have to do is perform pirouettes at the right moment.

Of course, I will only rate your Grace as you perform pirouettes, and your reward will be lower than what you can earn if you follow the guiding aura properly.

If you change your mind, talk to me at any time before the Dance, and I'll remove the enchantment.

Well?

Done!

I believe in you: you will be able to perform the Ice Dance without any help in no time.

The ballroom is the largest room in the Galleon. Dancing requires a lot of space!

This year, thanks to a wonderful gift from the House de Blizare, we were able to organize a special event for our guests, the Great Ice Dance that I personally helped put together!

You absolutely must take part in it.
Catch 10 fairies flying over Irene in the form of a Free Bird.

, you must have run into fairies on Irene... Wonderful creatures, are they not?

And you have probably wondered... why do fairies look so similar to the elves? Well, let me give you a history lesson:

The transformation of elves that granted us wings was devised by the first mages of Irene. Back then, there was no Conclave, and they weren't even Great Mages as we understand them now, but they were already capable of many things. One of them, Elleken, could create miniature copies of elves using the Key of Creation. He tested his spells on them before using them on our brethren.

Elleken's power was great. He gave magic powers to these fairies who had none of their own. He also gave them the ability to fly...

We would like to have a few fairies for our celebration. It's easy to catch them. Thankfully the House de Pluie is willing to lend everyone their Mask of the Free Flight that allows you to turn into a bird and fly high in the sky!

Now go get Us a few fairies.

Good afternoon, !

The Great Ball has its own tradition - it ends with the Royal Hunt.

We think it would be nice to uphold this tradition.

Our House organized this hunt in the forests of Egladien! Yes, the forests where the Battle for Beauty was once fought.

Back then our ancestors, ancient elves, fought to protect their borders from vermin... Trolls, Ogres, Gremlins...

Fortunately, we managed to throw them back. Egladien is a peaceful place now! But even a peaceful place like this has its own magic... It's connected to the local hedgehogs - despite their amicable appearance, they can handle themselves!

So your task is to catch as many hedgehogs as you can... Or get away from the hunters! You'll know more once you join in.

Happy hunting!
How did the hunt go? Who won? Hunters or hedgehogs? How curious...
A good hunt is great both for the body and mind!

Noblemen are hunting noble beasts! Well, almost...

Our House decided to create a more accessible version of an ancient form of entertainment - horseback hunting!

Except we have deer instead of horses and enchanted Irene Hedgehogs instead of game. That's should make it easier and more exciting!

There's nothing tricky about it: just mount a deer and try to catch a hedgehog with a magic net, and if you get bored, you can become a hedgehog yourself!

You can pick a role and tell me about it: magic will take care of the rest.

If you want to join as a hunter, we will give you an Irene Deer and a magic net. Your objective is to catch as many enchanted hedgehogs with it as you can! You can catch any number of them - the hedgehogs enjoy this activity!

If you want to become prey, we will cast a spell on you that will turn you into a hedgehog. Run away from hunters - the longer you stay uncaptured, the more points you will earn! You can run for as long as you want - until you get tired or bored.
We're happy to see the famous hero we heard so much about! Welcome to Irene, the glorious city of Ker-Is, to the royal court!
Complete Rosie de Tristesse's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

After Antoinette told us about her daughter Gala's mission on that... Umoir, His Majesty the king ordered that the Galleon Castle be steered towards Al Rihat Ruins so he can see everything with his own eyes. Since our new Galleon Castle keeps the Irene shards together, the cream of the elven society arrived at Catherina's domain. Now we can see everything ourselves.

According to Antoinette, her family is helping House de Tristesse restore this place. Indeed, rotting in ruins isn't the elven way of doing things!

So hear the will of His Majesty, ! You must render assistance to Rosie de Tristesse, the queen of the Patriarch's residence at the House de Tristesse. Obey her every command, and His Majesty will reward you generously. You can go now.

Vampires... I wonder if we can get along.

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!
Complete Andrew de Delice's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

His Majesty see that Al Rihat is doing well, but They also think that you could try harder. His Majesty took an interest in a certain Guardian Ring, especially one of its members, Andrew de Delice. We elves never paid any attention to this kind of magic. You know what I mean, don't you? All that... druidism, shamanism, and other quackery. They seem quite savage and uncivilized, but we might be wrong about them.

, help Andrew with his research. Perhaps, other elves might join this Ring later, after they study this strange magic.

Druidism... Interesting... Can it make me any more beautiful? I wonder if it's even possible!

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!
Complete Gorynya Ozornov's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

His Majesty watched you kill those... animals in Al Rihat Ruins. He was quite impressed with the strength and anger of the corrupted beasts! It's good to have someone protect House de Tristesse lands against them. His Majesty spoke of the hunters that hunt the beasts. Now we want you to help them.

, go there and do whatever you can to assist the hunters.

Fighting monsters should be quite interesting. I ought to try it some time.

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!
Complete Leticia de Desirae's daily quest at the Al Rihat Ruins

His Majesty has a big family, and Leticia is his beloved niece. She dreams about glory, and wants to be a monster huntress. Al Rihat is a perfect location. I think she'll looking for some heroes to help her.

Here's His Majesty's wish, : go to Al Rihat Ruins and complete Leticia de Desirae's quest.
I doubt these animals that Leticia is hunting can scare you off. But I’d still call a few friends if I were you. Just to be safe.

Oh, the young maidens on a battle horse, with a sword in their hands! How they charge into battle!

You've managed to complete the mission. I'll report this to His Majesty. But I expect you to keep up the good work in the upcoming days!
You have the honor of representing His Majesty's interests in the lands of Al Rihat. You'll be rewarded, of course.

I have no tasks for you right now.

His Majesty's interests in Al Rihat are represented by ambassadors with proper combat training and certain reputation level with the royal family.

In your case it's just a formality, but all formalities must be observed at the Court.

Come back later.
Brew or purchase from an Alchemist 10 Dragon Fervor aphrodisiacs and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the alchemical recipe from the Quartermaster of House de Blizare on Irene.

His Majesty tells me I can trust you completely. Great! I've got a lot to do.

You might have noticed that the cream of elven society gathers here. As you known, all elven ladies are beautiful, and all elven gentlemen are irresistible. All Great Balls are courtesy contests. And, of course, they keep count of romantic conquests.

That is why aphrodisiacs are in a very high demand! We're running out! We need more, much more of it. I'll appreciate it if you help me.
Excellent! Oh, the aroma! This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.
Produce or purchase from a Weaponsmith 5 rapiers and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the blueprint from the Quartermaster of House de Vevre on Irene

His Majesty wants me to give you tasks. I have quite a few for you.

Perhaps, you noticed that duels are now in high fashion among the nobility. I admit, there's certain beauty in them. The graceful movements, the fencing skills... Yes, there is something to it. His Majesty put a ban on duels, but all elves insist on carrying a rapier anyway.

We're almost out of them. But the visitors want more and more! We need to produce some new rapiers. I'm counting on you.
Great! Very fine steel. This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.
Craft or purchase from a Leatherworker 5 saddles for riding lions and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the recipe from the Quartermaster of House de Grandeur on Irene.

His Majesty told me I could ask you for anything... oh, and I do have a lot to ask!

You might have seen lions in the city. They're our domestic animals. They're perfect mounts for any elf! It can take you to your destination and protect you if need be. That's why there are so many of them in the city. Naturally, we need just as many saddles to ride the lions. Saddles wear out over time and need replacement.

Elves come to me for new saddles all the time. Unfortunately, we don't have that many! We're making preparations for a big event, after all. There's no room for leatherworking shops! But we do need saddles. Just a few would solve this problem. Or a part of it, at least.
Awesome! Great leather. This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.
Sew or purchase from a Tailor 5 pairs of formal gloves and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the pattern from the Quartermaster of House de Pluie on Irene.

His Majesty wants me to give you some assignments for the good of elves. That's exactly what I'm planning to do.

What do you think is missing at the Ball? Formal gloves! They're so delicate and soft that they wear out pretty fast. Everyone wears gloves around here. We're on a verge of the glove crisis! There's going to be a scandal unless I can provide enough gloves for all the guests!

I beg you, help me find formal gloves! Whatever it takes!
Magnificent! Great tailoring! This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.
Craft or purchase from a Blacksmith 5 chain links for the Galleon Castle and deliver them to Irene. You can purchase the blueprint from the Quartermaster of House de Ardeur.

On behalf of His Majesty, I'd like to give you another assignment.

You have probably noticed that the Galleon Castle, House de Ardeur's creation, is holding the shards of Irene together with chains. If it weren't for them, the astral streams would tear this archipelago apart. Not only they are holding the allods together, they also allow us to move them through the astral. That's how we've reached Umoir.

However, nothing lasts forever. We constantly check the chain links and replace old ones. Alas, forging new links isn't easy! We don't have enough metal... or blacksmiths. I urge you to bring me several chain links so we could use them as a replacement.
Breathtaking! Heavy and tough. Just what we need. This is just what we needed! I'll make sure to let His Majesty know about this.
Sign the Dragon Acquisition Permit at the heads of seven Great Houses on Irene and bring it to Anastasia de Vevre.

This document states:

According to this document, the petitioner is worthy of assuming the responsibility for the Irene Viper. May they continue to be worthy of such honor, and may they glorify their name by exploits and noble deeds in the name of all elves and the seven Great Houses.

This paper must be signed by seven heads of the seven Great Houses. But first, you'll have to earn the elves' trust.
Wow! Heads of the Great Houses managed to agree on something? It's hard to believe. How did you do it? You're a true hero. A great hero, .

But they can't do it on their own. They need help. The dragons tried to create their own... First Priest... Lickflame Tinderbox. He was the only one that could open the Star Gates with the Key. Neither Soliskar nor Agrus can do it. Now that they're dead, the dragons are trying to create new ones... or find an ally among the Great Mages. Mages whom they deeply hate. However, strange times call for strange alliances. You know what lies ahead. I'll sign your permit.
h: Dragons want to leave Sarnaut... and return home?

t: We were so close to victory! The thing is, if this Ball had taken place ten years ago, we would have won... The Galleon is still magnificent, but it's yesterday's news. Perhaps we should think of something new? We could continue developing the Galleon Castle's AI. She can't do much right now, but with time she might evolve into something greater.
h: I give my vote to the House de Ardeur!

t:
Ah, I see you're resorted to discrediting tactics? I have to admit, I'm impressed... I wonder how you figured that out, I could swear I left no evidence!

Well done ! You are becoming an expert in espionage. As for Marion: firstly, I deny everything, and secondly, you yourself said at the trial that vampires are not to blame. It's all Armando's fault. Thirdly, she's too good a lover.
h: I know you are seeing Marion de Doucer! And she's a vampire!

t: I hope no one expects us to abandon our plans even if Antoinette wins?
We will win next time. And then...

I've seen a lot of beautiful but largely impractical things.

A painting? Lovely, but we have plenty of those. All palaces are covered with pictures of naked maidens and steamy scenes! A concert? I'm sorry, but I'm not a fan of ethnic music. I prefer opera. An alliance with vampires? Don't make me laugh.

So only the statue and potion remain. Both can be useful in times of war. I must decide what's more useful.

Although, Marianne here enjoyed both the music and the painting. Fine, I'll support the creator. It's decided. House de Pluie!
Find out what is going on between the cardinal and the queen.

It’s time to settle all our misunderstandings. Antoinette wants Iris to be returned to her. Cardinal holds her captive.

Well, it’s time to return the prodigal daughter to her family and resolve this conflict between Houses de Delice and de Ardeur.

We want you to handle it. Find out the cause of these issues.
We should make sense of our subjects’ relations before the Ball.

It looks like we’ve managed to at least cool the conflict. Victory at the Great Ball will put an end to this whole story. There will be one victor - either Antoinette or Renard.

Well, We’ll be glad to be free of the burden of authority.
I knew Renard had a hand in this. It’s outrageous.

Louis wants everyone to get along!

But Renard has gone too far. House de Delice has the right to do what they think is necessary. I admit we shouldn’t have made Iris a mediator between me and Yasker... But we should be able to negotiate freely.
h: The king is asking me to settle your disputes.

t:
Oh please, me and Yasker have known each other for a while. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

What matters is he’s willing to listen.
h: You were secretly negotiating with Yasker?! How could you?

t:
I’m glad you understand. I’ve known Yasker a long time. In 957, he occupied Ignis... They even made a... what was it... a “motion picture” about it. Of course, it wasn’t accurate.

But it laid the ground for negotiation. Just don’t tell Rysina. She can’t know about this.
h: It’s good that someone still strives for peace.

t: Meet with Louis in Galleon Castle.

And now the reason we’re all here on Irene: the Great Ball!

Each of the Great Houses will show what they are capable of and demonstrate their greatest achievement... The demonstration will take place in Galleon Castle of House de Ardeur, a creation that is a contender on its own.

It’s time to see it. Go, We’ll meet you there.

Look around you! If our wings were capable of flying, and Our position allowed us to engage in frivolous activities...

Well, let’s get down to business. It will begin soon.
Find and pacify 5 dodge balls scattered around the room.

As usual, there is trouble. Dionysius from Ammer provided us with dodge balls from Dionic Games for testing. But alas, they are scattered around the room. We need to find and pacify them before they start hitting guests. We don’t want that, right? Though Orcs will probably be ecstatic... But we’re not here for them. So please help, we’re running out of time!
Please bring them back. Nothing should delay my performance.
Oh, wonderful. Everything is in order! I hope no one was hurt?
Find Tamira Windsong in the room and persuade her to return to the band.

Sooo! My worry was not unfounded. Tamira is missing! The star from Howlem! It'll be our turn soon! Tamira plays an important part at the beginning and the end of the symphony.

She is well-trained and will be impossible to replace at the last moment! Find her quickly and bring her here.
Where is my bugler? Without her, the symphony wouldn’t sound right! It would be imperfect!
Where is my bugler? Without her, the symphony wouldn’t sound right! It would be imperfect! Oh, what a relief! Everyone is here now!
Oh, what a relief! Everyone is here now!

Listen... When I saw all these important people, I got scared... Now I’m afraid to go there... And perform? I feel nervous! I can’t breathe!

I believe the band can do without me! I’m sorry.
h: What are you doing here? Caspar is looking for you.

t: Anyone can pick up the bugle and play! You just need to blow hard!
h: Your instrument is an important part of the symphony!

t: There are many Pridens! Ask any of them! Anyone will agree if you ask them!
h: You are representing a Priden tribe, the band won’t be complete without you.

t: Participate in the opening ceremony and the demonstration of accomplishments of the Houses de Blizare, de Vevre, and de Grandeur.

You’ve helped the Heads of the Houses with their preparations before... Well, they wish to tell you they could use your help again. This time they will show the results. And we could use you, the Hero of Sarnaut, to draw more attention to the event. Let’s not refuse them.
It’s not just an hour of triumph for them, . It’s a turning point for their House. And our House as well.
Incredible demonstration worthy of the Great Houses! We are proud you’ve taken part in it.
Help Maximilien de Blizare demonstrate the new potion.

Is there anyone better for a demonstration than the Hero of Sarnaut?

Yes, yes. With you, the show will be unforgettable! I’ll remember your help and reward you...

The task is simple: Irene fairies will be flying around the central platform of the ballroom. You need to catch all the fairies, but they are not easy to catch – you will need to drink my Potion of Time to slow them down.

There is one “but”: among the fairies you’ll see the dodge balls I enchanted earlier, and if one of them hits you, you will lose the effect of the potion.

I believe your task is clear: catch the fairies and dodge the balls. Come on, it’ll be fun! Go! I’ll release them as soon as you start!
This time everything should be perfect.
Wow, that was incredible. Everyone in the room was able to see the effects of my potion... Thank you.
Listen to Caspar’s speech and assume the role of conductor.

Oh, I’m starting to get nervous...

Oh well, here goes nothing... Let’s start. You will conduct. Your task is to help the musicians play by showing which part should be performed at the moment. It shouldn't be too difficult. I’m sure you can handle it! I’ll be playing the guitar! Let’s remember the good old days!
Just look at the sheet music, it will tell you what to do.
Excellent! Epic! That was... quite inspiring. Thank you for your help, it’s an invaluable experience.
Defeat the statue of the Forest Mistress.

Alright... It’s time to show the true power of ancient elves!

You’ve controlled it before... It’s impressive, isn’t it? Now you need to fight it and try to defeat it... Don’t be afraid of destroying it. The enchantment protects the statue from any damages. It will restore itself after a while.

I’m more scared for you, to be honest. Well, you’ve fought gods and dragons before, you can survive this!
What a fight! Almost like the Battle for Beauty. It looks like the proximity of Egladien makes her stronger. I’ll need to conduct some experiments in the forest...
Help the Great Houses prepare for the competition.

The Great Ball will soon begin, and the Great Game is on! Each House seeks ways to demonstrate whatever they have prepared.

A heated competition is a risky venture! The rules of competition demand that the participants create obstacles for each other. There's a certain limit, of course. The participants can't get carried away. Dirty tricks are considered bad form. However, there's no objection to reasonable, removable obstacles. It's all about prestige, after all.

This is why your task is to visit the heads of certain Great Houses and find out about their needs and problems. And, of course, help them solve them.
Well, how are you doing? I hope the heads of the Houses won't be at each other's throats before we can even announce the winner.
Well, I'm sure we'll see the result of your preparations at the Great Ball!
Drink the potion of time and destroy 10 Echoes of the Past in the residence of House de Blizare.

I'm afraid we have serious problems now.

The head of our House, the Great Mage Maximilien de Blizare, wants to demonstrate a unique potion which can alter our perception of time. He decided to test the potion on himself and make sure the final formula worked, but something went wrong.

Maximilien got trapped in a temporal anomaly which let the ghosts of the pasts, the astral hounds, into our world. They found their way to Irene when the key got lost and the protective barrier collapsed. The Astral flooded the town.

Now the ghostly demons wander about the residence, becoming more and more real!

I beg you, kill the hounds, destroy the temporal anomaly, and set Maximilien free!

The only way to meet the hounds is to drink the experimental potion... and pray that whatever happened to Maximilien won't happen to you...
Get rid of these echoes of the past. The fewer of them are left, the faster Maximilien will destroy this anomaly.

I'm quite impressed and grateful, . I must refine my recipe to avoid anything like this during the Ball.

I'm sure I've been framed! The formula couldn't be wrong!

It's the House de Delice's intrigues, I'm sure! The girls are overly interested in my new assistants!

Please don't tell anyone what happened. I don't want my reputation to take a hit.
Catch 5 pages of sheet music carried away by the wind in the House de Vevre's residence.

Greetings, ! I could use your help. I want to impress the audience and throw a gala concert in the ballroom of the Galleon Castle! All races will be invited to participate!

I'm all for the elves' independence and friendship with all nations. I want to set an example for the Great Houses and assemble an interracial orchestra where each plays a part of their own.

Everything's almost ready. Rehearsal is at the final stage. Unfortunately, the wind carried away my sheet music. If the townsfolk find them, they'll learn about my surprise. It'll ruin everything!

Help me collect the pages.
If my creation is blown all over Irene, my reputation will be ruined.

What would I do without you?

I'm sure it's the mages of House de Grandeur! They want to sabotage my show, so they conjured the wind in my residence to thwart my rehearsal.
Hah! Do you want my signature? You know what? I'll sign it. But you have to prove your worth to my House first.

Dragons. My people are infatuated with them. You know the history. We wanted to be like them. Many of us are still drawn to them. And Anastasia, too... I think you both have a similar appreciation for their beauty and grace. I have one of her ballads – it's about a dragon. A dragon who knows his days are numbered. Dragons don't belong in our world. Alas! Is that what you think?
, welcome to the glorious House de Vevre! I'm Caspar de Vevre, head of the House, and the Great Mage of the Florenta allod.

I'm glad you've come to me.

House de Vevre is famous for its love to fine arts and music. There are a great many bards in my House. On my allod, we even have a bard academy, which provides professional education in music creation. Besides, we have excellent scouting skills. There is no secret that our oracles cannot reveal.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are elegant harpies. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Aquila de Vevre will join you. She's a talented musician, who will cheer you up in your travels.

Here's your cherry on top: we found a great number of ancient artifacts, known as Moon Dragon Armor. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.
h: I want to know more about House de Vevre patronage

t:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are elegant harpies. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Aquila de Vevre will join you. She's a talented musician, who will cheer you up in your travels.

Here's your cherry on top: we found a great number of ancient artifacts, known as Moon Dragon Armor. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.
h: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Vevre?

t: Help Albert and Baudouin de Grandeur restore the old spell.

Greetings. We could use some help.

Here's the deal: my brother Albert and I, Baudouin, want to restore the spell that revives and grants control over legendary elven statues of heroes of the past. Yes, it's like in the Winter Palace. Once they were legendary heroes, back in the day of the Battle for Beauty. Even after death, they're guarding the borders of Irene as statues.

Let's begin with the Forest Mistress. You know how to control them. You're a good choice for a test. We'll give you the ability to control her. You need to see if she obeys your orders. To check, we'll use a shooting range. Listen carefully to everything we tell you and do as we say.

Thank you for your help! Its strength is fantastic, isn't it?

You'll meet them again during the Ball.
Find paint for Guillaume de Pluie.

Such barbarity!

Someone added solvent to my beautiful paints! It's a nightmare. Do I need to have another batch delivered from Tempesta? Or we can use whatever we have at hand...

Hey, , listen... since the king sent you to help me, please, make yourself useful! Find something... I need ALL paints, do you understand? Do something! Now!
I can't complete a painting without my paints! It's all lost!

It's time to take a brush and reproduce this untold beauty on canvas. Go now. Go. Don't get in the way of my creation.

I'm sure House de Blizare's patented alchemists are behind it. Savages!
Talk to the elves released from the Igsh Military District prison.

Greetings, comrade !

Everything's according to our plan. So far it's going as planned: you infiltrated the elven community and earned their trust.

Now I need to know the opinion of the elves recently freed from Termitka prison. Speak with them. And remind them that the League has let them down. We don't need their gratitude. We only need them no stop trusting the League.

Start with these elves: Germain de Grandeur, Landelin de Pluie, Annabelle de Vevre, Herluin de Blizare. They're in their Houses' abodes.

Visit them and talk.
They must never forget what the Empire did for them!

Well, that's understandable.

According to my calculations, people's opinions are now fifty-fifty. We only need to tip the scale.
Hmm... did they let you in here? Unwise...
It's wonderful. My mind and body are relaxing after your prison. And look at all the beautiful girls!
h: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: Hmm. I'm a professional scout. I used to recruit agents on Igsh. I was caught, arrested, and sent to prison. Now I need to figure out what to do next. I might use the Hall of Changes: dye my hair, change my face, or even become a lovely lady for the time being, hehe. But holidays first.
I'm glad to see the League's renowned hero!

I know they've been trying. They dropped off their troops on Igsh, captured the XAES... it's a shame it didn't work! But I guess there's only so many battles you can win. If the plan worked, we would have won the war. The way things went... well, there was peace and the anti-architectural alliance.
h: How do you feel about being freed by the Empire and not the League?

t: Wonderful! Just look at all the beautiful girls! My mind and body are relaxing after the Imperial prison.
h: How do you like it here on Irene?

t: Talk to the elves released from the Igsh Military District prison.

Good afternoon, friend !

I think, we were able to show the elves that they'd be better off with the League. You've earned their trust and run errands for them.

We've got another issue. I've come to know that Yasker released all elves from the Termitka prison in IMD. It pains me to say this, but we failed to set them free, although we tried. I ask you to speak with them and pass on our sincere apologies. Put things in perspective, disrupt their faith in the Empire.

Start with these elves: Germain de Grandeur, Landelin de Pluie, Annabelle de Vevre, Herluin de Blizare. They're in their Houses' abodes.

Visit them and talk.
They must understand that the League can give them protection.

Well, that's understandable.

According to my calculations, people's opinions are now fifty-fifty. We only need to tip the scale.
Figure out where to find Iris de Delice.

Yes, yes, I get it. The only thing I'm worried about is the hostility between arch-duchesse and the cardinal. They both are dear to me. It's Antoinette de Delice and Renard de Ardeur. We need to find balance before they break up forever.

We can convince Renard, but it's harder to persuade Antoinette. We need to come up with something. I hear she has a problem with one of her daughters. The poor thing has been kidnapped. Her ship was captured by the Imperial patrol. Her companions died, but her fate was different.

She and several other girls were forced to dance for high-ranking Imperial officials in a hole called Bunker for many years to come...

She was disgraced and refused at the court. I could make an exception and bring her back on my royal command. But first, we need to know where she is.

House de Delice is quite artful and trained in diplomacy. I suggest you ask our orcish friend Skulnar the Fierce for help. Luckily, he's currently staying at House de Delice residence. He's been invited over there just recently.

That's what I call the will of steel! He hasn't given himself away with a single thought. I fear to imagine what they do to train their brothel bouncers, hehe.

I'm completely sure that your Iris is hiding in there. It's the safest place on the allod. You'd better stay away from the bouncer. If he feels offended, we'll have to storm the brothel like we always do. Let's think of a way to sneak in there.
Greetings, my dear friend. What brings you here?

Hello there! Here you are, . Want see a local specialty? Huh! They say de Delice have something that no one has ever seen here before.

Hey, what's with the face? The king and his missions again, eh? What are they after, huh? Go on, spit it out.
Women are nothing but trouble. Let's just ask her directly.
h: I need to figure out Antoinette's problem with her daughter, Iris.

t: Enter the Rose and Hibiscus and find Iris de Delice.

Their brains are tough, but we aren't simpletons, either. They don't want it our way, then why don't we play along? You'll speak, . My mug is too ugly for this place.

Well, what does it take to let us in?

That's impossible! Nothing gets past me! Your Iris must be flapping her wings in the far corner of the garden!

What's that? Booze? Cool. Give it here!
You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures.

Oh traveler! You are standing before the gates that lead to eternal joy! Everyone that enters should know: your wishes are heard! You will find here what you have been looking for!

What are you looking for?
We don't disclose information about our visitors. Overly intrusive and prying individuals shall be banned.
h: I hear the arch-duchesse is looking for her daughter. I wonder where she might be.

t: You must be under the guise of Ardent Love to enter the Garden of Pleasures. Thing is, our visitors are hiding their identities. This allows them to feel relaxed and not fear the consequences. A pleasure is only a pleasure when you don't have to pay a price. Those wanting to enter must contribute by purchasing this mask from a hostess, who controls the gifts of our beautiful and generous arch-duchesse.
Find our where Iris de Delice is

There was a weird elven lady here. Nothing special, especially for a place like this, hehe. She's wearing a mask, but I noticed a strange serpent decoration. Why don't you look around this flowerbed and search for Iris? I'll join you later. I need more time here.

Look, there she is! The serpent lady! She crossed the bridge, heading outside. Hurry! Get there before she leaves!

I don't think Mademoiselle Eurial is the one she says she is. I'll try and find out more. In the meantime, carry out your missions here, on Irene.

As for Iris and Renard, I'll talk to His Eminence and ask him to return the wayward daughter to her family. Don't tell anyone. I want it to be a surprise.
Entertain Skulnar and have fun together.

! Everything went well, and now it's finally time to have some rest and remember your friends.

Skulnar was looking for you. Go find him and have some fun. We won't be needing your help for the time being.

See? And people were laughing! I knew I was right to add some of my juice...

That potion was a strange one, I've only just sobered up... Ah, no, I haven't.

Listen, why are we just drinking? I have an idea...

When we drank that potion, I noticed that a centaur entered the room.

Could you talk to him and ask him to... well... give us a ride? Imagine the show we can put on!

But we'll have to leave Murk here, let him sleep it off... He's not used to something like this!
Ah... You're awake? That was quick...
Find Murk and Skulnar the Fierce.
You look lost... Has something happened?
